name: lucy-ping
description: Ring Lucy's doorbell from Claude Code: /lucy-ping [send <text> | retry | status [eventId]] through the Lucy bridge.

bridge_url.title: Bridge URL
bridge_url.description: Public HTTPS origin of the lucy bridge, e.g. https://lucy-bridge.vercel.app

ping_token.title: Ping token
ping_token.description: Bearer token the bridge expects on POST /ping (BRIDGE_PING_TOKEN).
